name: Vegetable Biryani with Saffron, Potato, Cauliflower, Raisins & Cashews

instructions.primary_message: Place milk in a small saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Once simmering, remove from heat, add saffron, and gently stir to combine. Cover and set aside until ready to serve.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup whole milk
2 pinch saffron threads

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat. Once the liquid comes to a boil, add spices, then stir to combine the mixture. Cover the saucepan and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, until ready to serve.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
green cardamom, whole
cinnamon stick
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp cumin seeds

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.

Once the pot is hot, add ghee and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and starting to caramelize, about 10 minutes. Transfer onions to a small bowl and set aside. (Reserve pot for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp ghee (clarified butter)
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium head cauliflower
2 (1 inch) piece ginger root
½ small pkg fresh mint
½ small bunch cilantro
½ lime

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice potatoes. Place in a medium bowl.
Separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the potato.
Return pot to medium-high heat, add more ghee, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add spices and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp ghee (clarified butter)
green cardamom, whole
cinnamon stick
3 bay leaf
1 tsp garam masala
½ tsp cumin seeds
½ tsp turmeric, ground
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add potato, cauliflower, and water to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 8-10 minutes. Adjust heat under the pot (or add small portions of additional water, as needed, to prevent scorching). (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and medium dice carrots. Place in the reserved bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the carrots.

When the potato and cauliflower are done, add carrots, ginger, garlic, and salt to the pot. Reduce heat to medium, cover, and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until carrots are tender, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the carrots are done, juice lime into the pot. Add yogurt and half of the herbs, then stir to combine (reserve remaining herbs for serving). Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until some of the liquid has evaporated, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat and discard cardamom pods, cloves, cinnamon, and bay leaf.
Uncover rice and discard cardamom pods, cinnamon, cloves, and bay leaves, then fluff with a fork to separate the grains.

To serve, transfer 2/3 of the rice to a platter, spreading out in an even layer. Top with 2/3 of the vegetable mixture and 2/3 of the caramelized onions. Repeat with remaining rice, vegetable mixture, and caramelized onions. Drizzle with saffron milk, then top with raisins, cashews, and reserved herbs. Enjoy!
